system.concept: Ancient Malkavian elder with a warring split personality
system.biography:
Background

Enslaved as a teenager in the Islamic world and Embraced circa 750 CE by Abd ar-Rahman, Jacob is a fifth-generation @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} elder secretly living in Milwaukee under two identities. As Jacob, he keeps a mansion on the fringe of Kindred territory in Greendale; as Esau, a split personality he created upon his Embrace, he keeps a condo north of downtown. The two personalities wage a private, decades-long war against one another using unwitting Kindred pawns (notably Turk of the Union, whom Esau has secretly Dominated). Jacob claims the Jyhad is a fiction and that all Kindred conflict is mundane rivalry; whichever mask he is wearing, his true goal is always the destruction of the other. Most Kindred who become entangled in the Jacob/Esau war die quickly, as each side always seems to know the other's plans.

Roleplaying Hints

Charming, paternal, and utterly insane beneath a distinguished veneer. Try to recruit anyone you meet into your side of the war against "my brother." Flatter, coax, and threaten as needed, but let your conversation grow subtly disjointed the longer it continues.
system.notes: Sire: Abd ar-Rahman. Havens: a mansion in Greendale (as Jacob) and a condo north of downtown (as Esau). Disciplines as printed: Auspex 6, Dominate 5, Obfuscate 5, Presence 6 (capped above to this system's 1-5 scale). Signature powers: Insight of the Mad (Auspex) and Coax (Presence), used together to compel others toward his hidden agenda.

system.description: Originally used to lead warrior-caste mystics on vision quests, this vizier technique lets a willing seer bring companions with him into the astral realms. All would-be participants must form an unbroken chain of physical contact with the character. Spend a Blood Trait for each "follower" you wish to bring along, up to a maximum of half your permanent Mental Traits (rounded down), then leave your body as per Psychic Projection. Each follower is treated as though she knows Psychic Projection regardless of her actual Auspex rating, using the leader's rolled successes. On the astral plane, followers must remain within roughly 100 feet of the leader, tethered to him and unable to break the connection. Any follower who loses physical contact with the leader instantly returns to her body and loses three Mental Traits, falling unconscious for the rest of the night if this reduces her to zero Mental Traits.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait per follower (max half permanent Mental Traits, rounded down)

system.description: After concentrating for a round on a familiar person, place, or object and spending a Willpower Trait, you win a Simple Test to perceive everything happening around that subject while remaining aware of your own surroundings. Other Auspex powers may be layered on to glean more, provided their own challenges are won. You must have known the subject at least one night, and must bid two extra Traits for challenges concerning your own physical surroundings while divided between two places.
system.duration: As long as concentration is maintained

system.description: When issuing a Dominate command, spend a Blood Trait and decide how many future attempts to resist or recover memories you wish to crush, spending one Mental Trait per attempt (these Traits are unavailable the rest of the night, though Willpower expenditure restores them normally). If the subject tries to disobey or recover memories within that limit, agonizing pain incapacitates him for 10 minutes; the power fades once all guarded attempts have been used.
system.bloodCost: One Blood Trait, plus one Mental Trait per resisted attempt crushed
system.duration: Until the set number of resistance attempts are exhausted

system.description: Spend a Willpower Trait and win a normal Mental Challenge against a familiar target, regardless of distance, to establish mental contact as though eye contact had been made. Once contact is established, Dominate may be used on the subject normally; using this against another supernatural being costs an additional Willpower Trait.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus one more against supernaturals)
system.duration: As per the Dominate power used

system.description: Your skin has become as hard as stone, but loses none of its flexibility. It is now almost impossible to cut you, stake you, or do lasting physical damage to you. Opponents must defeat you in three successive tests to stake you (in addition to winning the necessary Physical Challenge). A character with Flesh of Marble doubles his Health Levels with regard to wounds of a physical nature. Flesh of Marble does not block Disciplines such as Death of the Drum or Cauldron of Blood.

You dampen observers' reactions to your activities, making anything you do seem far more tolerable than it should — so long as your actions are not physically threatening and you do not directly interact with the observer. Unlike most lesser Obfuscate powers, Blithe Acceptance remains in effect even if you affect your physical surroundings or act in an obtrusive manner (picking a lock, defusing a bomb, or rappelling down a building all pass unnoticed). Spend a Willpower Trait and two Mental Traits. Any observer who wishes to take exception to (or even take note of) your nonthreatening actions must defeat you in a Mental Challenge in which you win all ties. The Storyteller is the final arbiter of what counts as "nonthreatening."

vtmlarp.source: Milwaukee by Night, Chapter Three: The Kindred
